class.name: SoundFontFileReader
class.brief_description: Resource holding raw SoundFont bytes and sfloader callbacks.
class.description: SoundFontFileReader holds the raw bytes of a SoundFont 2 file in [member data] and implements the random-access surface ([method open], [method read], [method seek], [method tell]) used by the custom [code]fluid_sfloader_t[/code] in [FluidSynth]. It is produced by the SoundFont import plugin ([code]project/addons/midi/import_soundfont_plugin.gd[/code]) as [code].sf2str[/code]. Only the [code]data[/code] property and [method get_extension] are exposed to GDScript; the file-like methods are C++ helpers and [code]sf_*[/code] callbacks are internal.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Replaces the internal byte array with a copy of [param data].

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns a copy of the internal SoundFont bytes.

method.name: get_extension
method.description: Returns [code]"sf2str"[/code], the extension used by the SoundFont loader/saver.
